page.layout: One printed page, no marginal notes on this side. Running head with page number at the top. Running text in one column, with a small italic summary block set in the middle of the text, and a centred part heading "CONCLUSIO" before the last paragraph. The strip at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: perquandam prolepsin: nam cum dixisset, ipsos vocatos esse ad libertatem: ne Galatæ hoc intelligerent de licentia vitæ, quasi Christianis liceret viuere vt liberet: hanc cogitationem anteuertit, & à licentia ista carnali dehortatur: contra, hortatur ad quoddam seruitutis genus, nempe vt alij aliis seruiant ex charitate, quam tanquam fontem & caput officiorum Christianorum proponit, vsque ad v. 16. inde de luctâ carnis & spiritus, vsque ad v. 19. à quo vsque ad finem capitis est Catalogus operum carnis siue naturæ non regenitæ, & fructuum spiritus, i. regeneratorum: inprimis autem enumerat ea vitia, quibus Galatas videbat deditos, vt ostendat, quàm procul abessent à dilectione proximi, atque ita ab observatione Legis.

p.i: V. 16: qui est vltimus capitis quinti, ad speciales exhortationes accedit, quas continuat cap. 6. vsque ad v. 11. vbi est Conclusio epistolæ.

main_text.p: Cap. VI. partes duæ sunt: primo enim per-sequitur Apostolus speciales admonitiones, & ea quæ θελικῶς[?] de fructibus spiritualibus dixerat, magis hypotheticè Galatis applicat, eosque hortatur ad quædam officia, quæ sunt effecta partim manfuetudinis & longanimitatis, partim charitatis, vsque ad v. 11. Secunda pars est
main_text.head: CONCLUSIO
main_text.p: Huius epistolæ, ad quam transit per locum attentionis, quo excitat Galatas ad considerandum laborem suum in scribendo ad ipsos: Deinde ad detegendum Pseudoapostolorum fucū, & Galatarū animos à falsa ipsorum doctrina avocandos, se cum iis comparat, vsque ad v. 18. quem Valedictio occupat.

page.notes: The left margin strip shows the edge of the facing page and was left out. The Greek word after "quæ" is uncertain (marked [?]). The word "perquandam" is printed without a visible space and is copied as seen. The summary block between the paragraphs is set in smaller italic type within the text column, so it is given as a footnote-style paragraph.
